contract.name: Mandatory-voluntary disclosure semantic wedge
contract.mechanism: Selective allocation of topics between mandatory and voluntary public disclosures can encode information beyond document size, complexity or generic sentiment.
contract.event_clock: SEC acceptance timestamp for the filing/disclosure package; historical prefix frozen at the public boundary.
contract.direction: two-sided outcome; no sign assumed ex ante

time_contract.acceptance_datetime_representation: SEC ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME is a local wall-clock timestamp in America/New_York; the raw 14-digit value is preserved before timezone-aware conversion.
time_contract.conversion_rule: Convert the raw SEC header acceptance timestamp to an aware America/New_York datetime, then compare XNYS market-open instants in UTC.

feature_construction.document_scope: Primary document text from the exact paired filings only; no later documents.
feature_construction.html_normalization: Decode entities; remove script/style nodes; collapse whitespace; preserve textual order.
feature_construction.tokenization: UTF-8 lowercase ASCII-alphanumeric tokens matching [a-z0-9]+; no fitted vocabulary and no learned stopword list.
feature_construction.topic_representation: Deterministic 64-bucket SHA-256 token hashing; bucket = first 8 hex digits modulo 64.
feature_construction.unigram_presence: Binary presence of hashed unigram buckets.
feature_construction.bigram_frequency: L1-normalized hashed adjacent-token bigram frequencies using SHA-256(pair) modulo 64.

features.omission_asymmetry_by_topic: mean absolute difference of the 64 L1-normalized unigram-frequency buckets
features.secondary_framing_gap: 1 - cosine similarity of the 64 L1-normalized bigram-frequency buckets

outcome_contract.action_session: first XNYS trading session strictly after pair_closure_clock
outcome_contract.direction: signed two-sided; no ex-ante sign assumption
outcome_contract.price_source: Yahoo Finance daily chart quote OHLC from the repository's established Yahoo historical market-data source family; corporate-action events remain in the frozen raw response, while dividend cash flows are not modeled.
outcome_contract.missingness: Any missing action-session open/close is DATA_INSUFFICIENT; no imputation.

independent_replication.universe_rule: Complete fixed issuer list; all eligible event pairs in the same fixed window are used without outcome-based filtering.
